title: Contract Management Manager
description:
Job Title:           Contract Management Manager
Location:          100% remote
Duration:         3-6 months Contract with potential extension
Pay rate:          $78.33/hr. on W2

Job Description:
The Contract Management Manager is responsible for managing the contract life cycle/contracting process for a sales team, from initiation through execution, including administration of assigned contract portfolio.
 
Essential Duties/Principal Responsibilities
 
  • Review contract requests and client paper contract submissions.
  • Work with the stakeholders to obtain any missing documents, and background/context for the request.
  • Set up kickoff call if needed to fully understand business intent of the negotiation.
 Legal Contract Reviews / Drafting / Negotiation /Maintenance
  • Decide on whether there is template suitable for the contract request. If so, work with stakeholders to update template as needed
  • If reviewing a third party contract, complete initial review and identify areas of deviation from Client's standards or business capabilities/intent. Update draft to reflect more standard terms based on your knowledge of  risk tolerance and business requirements
  • Coordinate internal and external calls, track and provide status updates, follow up with internal requestors as appropriate to continue deal momentum.  
  • Facilitate collaboration and feedback from stakeholders and incorporate feedback into contract.
  • Prepare execution version including document proofing for section cross references, defined terms, and exhibit references. 
Process and Training
  • Suggest ways to develop and implement contract process and best practices based on your observations of what would be best for the organization with the intent of reducing contract turn time; update as needed.
  • Provide thoughts on policy development, such as provisions that require business approvals, and guidelines for legal engagement. Provide suggestions to improve processes to help ensure favorable outcomes for the business.
 Skills & Competencies
  • Ability to translate stakeholder and legal requirements into contract language.  Mastery of English language and grammar skills.
  • Familiarity with common contract terms and conditions for business and technology products and services, and professional services.
  • Understands typical contract language to mitigate risk and ensure service or product is delivered as expected.
  • Ability to work independently and apply good judgment in making decisions appropriate for their level.
  • Able to work effectively at all levels in an organization with various levels of stakeholders.
  • Discipline to maintain and follow standard processes for contract management.
  • Consistency in producing high quality deliverables.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Flexible and adaptable; able to juggle multiple priorities.
 Qualifications
  • 10 years of work experience, including at least 3 years of experience in reviewing, redlining and monitoring of SALES contracts or other commercial legal documents;
  • Bachelor's degree OR equivalent combination of education and experience;
  • Paralegal and/or Contract Management experience in a major in-house legal or contracting department;
  • Strong interpersonal skills needed;
  • Experience with OEM contracts is a plus;
  • Automotive industry experience is a plus;
  • Background in sales or sales support is a plus.

title: Business Analyst (EPIC)
description:
Job Title : Business Analyst (EPIC)
Location : Austin, TX (Position will be 2 days remote with 3 days (Mon, Tues & Thurs) required to be ONSITE)
Duration : 6+ months
 
 
Job Summary:
Agreeya is a System integrator and looking for a Business Analyst (EPIC).
 
Overview:
Understands business objectives and problems, identifies alternative solutions, performs studies and cost/benefit analysis of alternatives. Analyzes user requirements, procedures, and problems to automate processing or to improve existing computer system: Confers with personnel of organizational units involved to analyze current operational procedures, identify problems, and learn specific input and output requirements, such as forms of data input, how data is to be; summarized, and formats for reports. Writes detailed description of user needs, program functions, and steps required to develop or modify computer program. Reviews computer system capabilities, specifications, and scheduling limitations to determine if requested program or program change is possible within existing system.
The Business Data Analyst will primarily focus on analyzing existing business requirements to understand current functionalities, data flows, and pain points. The role will then leverage this understanding to elicit and write comprehensive business requirements for new systems or enhancements.
A key responsibility will be translating complex business needs into clear, actionable requirements. The role must be well-versed in writing Epics and User Stories, including acceptance criteria, to effectively communicate functional and non-functional requirements to development and quality assurance teams. The role will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to ensure alignment between business objectives and system capabilities.

The ideal candidate will possess strong data analysis skills, an ability to document current state processes, and a proactive approach to identifying opportunities for process and system improvements. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are essential for facilitating workshops, gathering information, and presenting findings to diverse audiences.
 
 
Minimum Requirements:
10 Required Hands-on experience as a business data analyst in the Information Technology industry, demonstrating strong analytical and documentation skills.
10 Required Proven ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical teams to analyze complex data-driven business problems and recommend actionable solutions.
10 Required Experience designing and optimizing data workflows and data management processes using modeling or mapping tools.
10 Required Well-versed in writing Epics and User Stories, including acceptance criteria, to effectively communicate functional and non-functional requirements to development and quality assurance teams
8 Required Experience creating and maintaining data-related documentation including data dictionaries, business requirement documents, and data mapping specifications.
8 Required Experience designing and presenting visual data models and dashboards to communicate trends, performance, and project timelines.
8 Required Demonstrated ability to lead data-focused meetings and interviews, document outcomes, and drive resolution of data-related issues.
4 Preferred bachelor's degree in data science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related field. Equivalent experience may be substituted.
4 Preferred Strong multi-tasking skills with the ability to manage multiple data projects or assignments concurrently.
3 Preferred Working knowledge of eligibility rules for SNAP, Medicaid, and TANF programs, with experience interpreting and applying state and federal guidelines.
3 Preferred Proven experience interpreting and applying policy within an integrated eligibility case management system.

title: Lead NOC Engineer
description:
Position Title                      ::        Lead NOC Engineer
Duration                              ::        Long Term Contract
Locations                             ::        Westerville OH

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership & Support

  • Lead a team of L2 network engineers in troubleshooting, diagnosing, and resolving complex network issues.
  • Provide technical mentorship, training, and performance reviews for L2 engineers.
  • Provide escalation support for advanced network problems beyond L1 capabilities.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive measures.
  • Oversee network and security infrastructure monitoring to ensure maximum uptime and performance.

Project Management, Documentation & Process Improvement

  • Develop and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs) for network troubleshooting and change management.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (L1, L3, security, infrastructure) for seamless network operations.
  • Ensure adherence to ITIL processes for incident, problem, and change management.
  • Lead network improvement projects, migrations, and new deployments.
  • Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, and inventory records.
  • Coordinate with vendors and service providers for network maintenance, upgrades, and SLAs.

Network and Security Operations & Optimization

  • Provide technical support for network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, VLANs, Firewalls, VPN, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, Wireless and Azure networks.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve network performance issues, outages, and security incidents in a timely manner.
  • Perform analysis, and capacity planning to ensure optimal performance and uptime.
  • Configure, maintain, and upgrade SDWAN routers, Cisco catalyst 9300 switches, Cisco FTD/Palo alto on prem and cloud firewalls, Infoblox grid and load balancers from vendors like Cisco, F5, Infoblox and Palo Alto.
  • Implement and maintain network security policies, including VPNs, ACLs, and firewall rules.
  • Work closely with L2 engineers to escalate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Support and troubleshoot SD-WAN, MPLS, and cloud networking solutions (AWS, Azure).
  • Collaborate with security teams to address vulnerabilities and compliance requirements.
  • Disaster Recovery planning and support, ensuring availability of applications during regular DR exercises by supporting network and security infrastructure.
  • Ensuring 24*7 Network availability by performing automated health checks across all on-prem/cloud Network/Security infrastructure.
  • Maintain network documentation, including topology diagrams, configurations, and incident reports.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams for network infrastructure improvements, migrations, and deployments.

 

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • 12+ years of experience in network administration, troubleshooting, and support.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, Routing protocol (BGP, OSPF), and switching solutions
  • Hands-on Experience on Cisco FTD, Palo alto, Meraki MX and Azure firewalls, Cisco Secure Client VPNs, and security best practices.
  • Hands-on Experience on F5 LTM and Azure load balancer (Application gateway, traffic manager and front door load.
  • Hands-on Experience on SDN based solutions SDWAN Viptela, SDWAN Meraki and Cisco Catalyst center.
  • Hands-on Experience on Infoblox DDI solutions and F5 global traffic manager.
  • Hands-on Experience with cloud networking (AWS, Azure) solutions and troubleshooting support.
  • Familiarity with network monitoring and packet analysis tools like SolarWinds, Netbrain, Live-NX, Lucid and wireshark
  • Experience on service now
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco, Palo Alto, Meraki, Viptela or other enterprise-grade network equipment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for complex technical issues.
  • Good communication and skills.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and team management skills.
  • Ability to handle high-pressure environments and 24/7 network operations.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, designing and documentation skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with automation tools (Ansible, Python, Terraform).
  • Exposure to VoIP, QoS, and multicast networking.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

Educational Qualification:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field.
  • A Master's degree in Networking, Telecommunications, or a relevant field is a plus but not mandatory.

Technical Certifications (Preferred but Not Mandatory):

  • Cisco Certifications: CCNA (mandatory), CCNP (highly preferred)
  • Juniper Certifications: JNCIA, JNCIS
  • Fortinet Certifications: NSE 4, NSE 5 (if dealing with Fortinet networks)

Other Relevant Certifications: Palo Alto PCNSE, AWS/Azure Networking Certifications

description:

Technical Leadership & Support

Project Management, Documentation & Process Improvement

  • Develop and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs) for network troubleshooting and change management.

  • Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, and inventory records.
  • Coordinate with vendors and service providers for network maintenance, upgrades, and SLAs.

Network and Security Operations & Optimization

  • Troubleshoot and resolve network performance issues, outages, and security incidents in a timely manner.
  • Perform analysis, and capacity planning to ensure optimal performance and uptime.
  • Configure, maintain, and upgrade SDWAN routers, Cisco catalyst 9300 switches, Cisco FTD/Palo alto on prem and cloud firewalls, Infoblox grid and load balancers from vendors like Cisco, F5, Infoblox and Palo Alto.

  • Work closely with L2 engineers to escalate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Support and troubleshoot SD-WAN, MPLS, and cloud networking solutions (AWS, Azure).
  • Collaborate with security teams to address vulnerabilities and compliance requirements.
  • Disaster Recovery planning and support, ensuring availability of applications during regular DR exercises by supporting network and security infrastructure.
  • Ensuring 24*7 Network availability by performing automated health checks across all on-prem/cloud Network/Security infrastructure.
  • Maintain network documentation, including topology diagrams, configurations, and incident reports.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams for network infrastructure improvements, migrations, and deployments.

 

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • 12+ years of experience in network administration, troubleshooting, and support.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, Routing protocol (BGP, OSPF), and switching solutions
  • Hands-on Experience on Cisco FTD, Palo alto, Meraki MX and Azure firewalls, Cisco Secure Client VPNs, and security best practices.
  • Hands-on Experience on F5 LTM and Azure load balancer (Application gateway, traffic manager and front door load.
  • Hands-on Experience on SDN based solutions SDWAN Viptela, SDWAN Meraki and Cisco Catalyst center.
  • Hands-on Experience on Infoblox DDI solutions and F5 global traffic manager.
  • Hands-on Experience with cloud networking (AWS, Azure) solutions and troubleshooting support.
  • Familiarity with network monitoring and packet analysis tools like SolarWinds, Netbrain, Live-NX, Lucid and wireshark
  • Experience on service now

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for complex technical issues.
  • Good communication and skills.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and team management skills.
  • Ability to handle high-pressure environments and 24/7 network operations.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, designing and documentation skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with automation tools (Ansible, Python, Terraform).
  • Exposure to VoIP, QoS, and multicast networking.

Educational Qualification:

  • Juniper Certifications: JNCIA, JNCIS

Project Description:
The Senior Quality Analyst will work along side both business and technical team members to ensure the usability and functionality of products, services and systems.  The role is responsible for analyzing requirements and issues for test case development and will execute and document all testing activities and results for new development, enhancements and issue resolution ensuring that the product and/or service meets the specified requirements. The role will interface with peer teams to identify, re-create and aid in the mitigation of any defects or anomalies found in the testing process; documenting all issues found in a defect tracking tool and reporting progress to management.
